caption: The drawing depicts two ornately shaped wooden objects, both featuring a hollow, rounded rectangular opening near their base. The object on the left is more elaborately decorated, with carvings and painted patterns in yellow, red, brown, and green hues; it also features a scalloped, shell-like motif at the top and zigzag and leaf-like designs along the sides. The object on the right is simpler, with a less prominent top section and light brown, almost beige wooden coloring with vertical wood grain lines and minimal decoration, showing only a couple of light-colored bands near the top. Both objects are presented against a plain, light-colored background.
title: Stirrup
